text: An innocent man, locked away for doing what was right.
Two young men entered the prison with him, and each had a dream.
One saw himself pressing wine. The other saw birds eating bread from his head. "Tell us what it means," they said, "we see that you are one of those who do good."
Even in a prison cell, people could see it.
But before he answered, Yusuf told them about Allah.
"O my two companions of prison, are separate lords better... or Allah, the One, the Prevailing?"
Then he gave the meaning. One of them would serve his master again. The other would not survive.
To the one he knew would go free, he said: "Mention me to your master."
And Yusuf remained in prison... for several years.
